tests.description: Dylan stays on floor, moves right and jumps
tests.name: dylan-moves
source: harness.assert(d0.y < 600, 'Dylan no atraviesa el suelo (y=' + d0.y + ')');
harness.assert(d1.centerX > x0 + 50, 'Dylan se mueve a la derecha con D (de ' + x0 + ' a ' + d1.centerX + ')');
harness.assert(d2.centerY < yBefore - 5, 'Dylan salta con W (de ' + yBefore + ' a ' + d2.centerY + ')');

tests.name: dylan-flip
source: harness.assert(harness.getRuntimeObject(d.id).isFlippedX() === true, 'Dylan mira a la izquierda (flip X activado)');
harness.assert(harness.getRuntimeObject(d2.id).isFlippedX() === false, 'Dylan mira a la derecha (flip X desactivado)');
